body: HYBOREM, Lord of the Infernals, the demon who broke out of hell to conquer the mortal world, leader of the Infernals in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: demon; male; ageless; towering and hulking, with massive shoulders and clawed hands. Deep crimson skin, a heavy brow over burning yellow eyes, fang tips at the corners of his mouth.
costume: black obsidian spiked armour with gold trim and a tattered dark red cape.
signature: Two huge curved black HORNS sweep up and back from his brow, whatever he wears.
extra: He is huge beside anything mortal, and wholly unhurried: his smile, when he smiles, is polite and holds no feeling at all.

vibes.name: Morality Is Wind
vibes.line: his right claw sliding one bone figure away from five others on the tablecloth, his left hand holding a wineglass by the stem; a tutor's polite closed smile, eyes calmly on the viewer; an endless dream dinner table, empty chairs dwindling into black haze, candle flames utterly still.
vibes.wears: a host's long midnight-blue velvet coat cut wide for his shoulders, silver buttons, a white silk cravat and lace at the cuffs.

vibes.name: Courteous Damnation
vibes.line: his right hand holding a black quill out across the altar, his left claw pinning an unrolled pact flat; head inclined in a polite nod, eyes lowered courteously to the parchment; the black-veiled sanctum of an Ashen Veil temple at midnight, cultists kneeling in the smoke, cold violet lamplight.
vibes.wears: a long ash-grey robe of state, a black silk stole embroidered with small silver seals, a heavy silver chain of office across his chest.

vibes.name: Hell Broken Loose
vibes.line: stepping out of a burning rift onto frosty farmland, his right claw crushing a fistful of frozen soil, his left hand gripping the rift's glowing edge behind him; head tipped back, nostrils flared, eyes half-closed toward the sky, tasting mortal air; pale pink dawn, frost on a farm fence.
vibes.wears: a war harness of blackened iron chains crossed over his bare crimson chest, spiked iron pauldrons, the links still glowing orange with hell's heat and steaming in the frost.

vibes.name: Lord of Ash
vibes.line: enthroned on jagged obsidian, his right claw letting a handful of grey ash trickle through its fingers, his left hand gripping the throne's arm; looking down at the viewer, eyelids heavy; a burning plain at night below, lava rivers, firelight from beneath rimming his horns, a sky of smoke.
vibes.wears: towering obsidian plate edged in gold filigree and spiked at every edge, a vast dark crimson cloak smouldering into embers at its hem, a crown of black iron spikes between his horns.
